title: The Property Set on Nothing: A Misspelt Name, a Binding That Was Assigned Over, and a Probe That Says So
fallback: This lesson is about reading and writing properties of a QML object from C++, so it needs Qt. Lesson 05-04 is about inputs a test did not think of, and lesson 05-05 about a fake that records what it was given. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: reading, writing and evaluating on a QML object so that a name that does not exist, a property that cannot be written and an expression that fails are each an error and not a silence
